Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapse and mine supply constraints support prices.

Coal.note: Structural demand decline from energy transition offsets near-term supply tightness.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and EV motor demand provide a floor despite weak spot data.

PGM.note: South African power constraints limit supply while hydrogen fuel cell demand grows.

Potash.note: Geopolitical supply disruptions and steady global agricultural fertilizer demand.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and rising green energy demand tighten the market.
